login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to Routy.
login.lockedError: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds}s.
login.setupSubtitle: No profile exists yet — create the first account.
login.setupTokenHint: Shown in the console when the container starts — check with "docker compose logs -f".
login.setupTokenError: The setup token is wrong or missing.
login.totpRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.totpError: That code is wrong or expired.

profile.title: Create a new profile
profile.subtitle: Every profile has its own stats but shares the same path network.

route.title: Suggest a route
route.noRouteFound: No route found within the configured length range.
route.noGoldenRoute: No route that uses today's golden path was found in the length range.
route.activeNotice: You have an active route. Confirm it as walked, or discard it to get a new suggestion.
route.discardConfirm: Discard this route? Won't count as walked.
route.completedMessage: Nice! Counts toward your stats now.
route.voiceHint: On arrival at a station, announces the next station and its direction (needs "Show my location").
route.voiceArrivedFinal: Arrived at {here}. That was the last station.
route.explorerModeHint: Prefers path segments that have never been walked.
route.surpriseModeHint: Prefers paths you have not walked in 30+ days.
route.favoriteStale: Route includes segments that have since been deleted — can't be taken anymore.
route.presetShortHint: Short route — fewer points, quicker finish
route.forceGoldenHint: Only suggest routes that use at least one of today's golden segments.

share.subtitle: Read-only, shared route.
share.notFoundBody: This link is invalid or is no longer shared.
share.openInAppHint: Opens the native app if installed on this device.

import.nameConflictWarning: A node named "{name}" already exists, {distance} m away. Use it anyway?
import.noTracks: No usable tracks found in this file.

map.title: Overview
map.subtitle: All known nodes and path segments — click for details.
map.interactionHint: Click a path or node to see details and available actions.
map.moveNodeActive: Drag active — drag the node on the map
map.deleteNodeConfirm: Delete this node and the {count} connected path segment(s)?
map.deleteBlockedNode: Can't be deleted — currently used by an active route.
map.deleteBlockedSegment: Can't be deleted — currently used by an active route.
map.autoPurgeNotice: Trash items are permanently deleted automatically after 30 days.
map.proposalsEmpty: No pending proposals from recent recordings.

overview.interactionHint: Click a path or node to see details and available actions.

record.instructions: Records your path by GPS while you walk — save it afterward like a drawn or imported path.
record.backgroundHint: Only works in the foreground with the screen on — browsers can't reliably record GPS in the background.
record.locationError: Couldn't get your location — location access required.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your profile and personal settings.
settings.networkSubtitle: Controls how generously nodes get merged and how routes are selected.
settings.merge_radius_m_hint: Points within this radius are treated as the same node.
settings.name_far_warn_m_hint: Warn when a same-named node is farther away than this.
settings.tolerance_percent_hint: How far a route may deviate from the target length.
settings.widen_step_percent_hint: How much the tolerance grows per "New route" click.
settings.daily_diversity_weight_hint: How strongly paths already walked today are penalized in new suggestions.
settings.walk_speed_kmh_hint: Default for profiles without their own value, and for GPX files with no timestamps.
settings.walkSpeedSubtitle: Overrides the network default for your profile — affects the estimated duration of new paths and routes.
settings.walkSpeedHint: Leave empty to use the network default (currently {default} km/h).
settings.suggest_min_km_hint: Lower bound of the length range a route is suggested from.
settings.suggest_max_km_hint: Upper bound of the length range a route is suggested from.
settings.adjust_step_percent_hint: How much the route changes on a "Longer" or "Shorter" click.
settings.passwordChangeError: Current password is wrong, or the new password is too short.
settings.logoutEverywhereSubtitle: Signs you out on every other device/browser — this session stays signed in.
settings.loggedOutEverywhere: All other sessions have been signed out.
settings.totpSubtitle: Require a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
settings.totpScanHint: Scan this with an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Google Authenticator), then confirm with the code it shows.
settings.totpConfirmError: That code is wrong or expired. Try again.
settings.totpEnabledStatus: Two-factor authentication is enabled on your account.
settings.deleteAccountSubtitle: Account will be deactivated — only the admin can reactivate it.
settings.avoidSubtitle: Routes will prefer other paths when possible — not a hard ban.
settings.avoidEmpty: You are not avoiding any paths.
settings.accountSecuritySubtitle: Change password, enable two-factor auth, or deactivate your account in the browser settings page.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle: Your walks, and how the path network is used overall.
stats.leaderboardEmpty: Nobody has walked yet this week.
stats.noSegments: No path segments in the network yet.
stats.deleteWalkConfirm: Delete this walk from your history? Stats adjusted accordingly.

game.dailyChallenge: Walk at least one golden path today for bonus points!
game.hubSubtitle: Walks earn points — golden paths and streaks multiply them.

draw.title: Draw on the map
draw.instructions: Click the map to place points. Near a known node (dashed circle) a click snaps to it automatically.
draw.dragHint: Drag a placed point to position it more precisely.

edit.title: Edit path
edit.subtitle: Drag points to correct the path's shape, add or remove points — or split the path at a new junction.
edit.splitBlockedActive: Can't be split right now — currently used by an active route.
edit.addPointHint: Click the path to insert a new point there. Click an interior point's marker to remove it again.
edit.splitModeHint: Click the path to split it into two segments at that spot.
edit.renameSegmentHint: Helps tell apart two paths that connect the same nodes (e.g. straight vs. around).

special.trailblazerDesc: Submitted a path segment of your own
special.longHaulDesc: Completed a walk of at least 10 km
special.weekWarriorDesc: Earned at least 200 points this week

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: User management, backups, and activity log.
admin.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this account? Login credentials are removed; nodes/paths they created stay attributed to their name.
admin.newPasswordHint: Only fill in to reset the password (min. 6 characters).
admin.resetTotpSubtitle: This account has two-factor authentication enabled. Reset it if they lost access to their authenticator app — they'll need to set it up again.
admin.backupDesc: Download a full copy of the database.
admin.insightsSubtitle: Household-scale snapshot — walks, golden hits, coverage.
